Review the gathered public evidence for an OSS Security KB maintenance pass. Candidates reviewed: Maven org.springframework:spring-core, PyPI MarkupSafe, npm lodash-es. Evidence is public OSV/GHSA/CVE/release metadata only. Propose evidence-backed KB updates. Do not fabricate findings; call out if a candidate should not be edited.

Focus on whether a new Maven spring-core page is warranted and summarize the main vulnerability themes from the evidence below.
# spring-core public evidence summary

Sources: OSV package query/details, GHSA aliases surfaced by OSV, Spring advisory/release links embedded in OSV references, Maven Central metadata.
